# Do Phylogenetic analysis

```{r}
extract_pp1_tree <- function(file_path) {
  library(ape)
  library(stringr)

  # Step 1: Read file
  tree_raw <- readLines(file_path)
  tree_text <- paste(tree_raw, collapse = "")
  tree_string <- sub("^.*tree [^=]+ = \\[&R\\] ", "", tree_text)

  cat("=== Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 2: Extract [&label="..."]: blocks
  label_pattern <- "\\[&label=\"(.*?)\"\\]:"
  label_matches <- str_match_all(tree_string, label_pattern)[[1]]
  cat("=== Raw Label Match Count ===\n")
  cat(nrow(label_matches), "metadata blocks matched\n\n")

  if (nrow(label_matches) == 0) stop("No valid metadata blocks found.")

  cat("=== First Metadata Block ===\n")
  cat(label_matches[1, 1], "\n\n")

  # Step 3: Extract pp1
  label_blocks <- label_matches[, 2]
  pp1_values <- sapply(label_blocks, function(x) {
    str_match(x, "pp1=([0-9\\.]+)")[, 2]
  }) |> as.numeric()
  cat("Extracted", length(pp1_values), "pp1 values\n\n")

  # Step 4: Clean tree string
  clean_tree_string <- str_replace_all(tree_string, label_pattern, ":")
  cat("=== Cleaned Tree String Preview ===\n")
  cat(substr(clean_tree_string, 1, 1000), "\n\n")

  # Step 5: Read tree
  tree <- tryCatch(
    {
      read.tree(text = clean_tree_string)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Error reading tree:\n", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (inherits(tree, "multiPhylo")) {
    cat("Tree is multiPhylo — using the first tree.\n")
    tree <- tree[[1]]
  }

  if (!inherits(tree, "phylo")) stop("Failed to parse tree properly.")

  # Step 6: Check internal nodes
  num_internal <- tree$Nnode
  cat("Tree has", num_internal, "internal nodes\n")

  # Step 7: Assign pp1 values
  if (length(pp1_values) < num_internal) {
    warning("Fewer pp1 values than internal nodes. Padding with NA.")
    pp1_values <- c(pp1_values, rep(NA, num_internal - length(pp1_values)))
  } else if (length(pp1_values) > num_internal) {
    warning("More pp1 values than internal nodes. Trimming.")
    pp1_values <- pp1_values[1:num_internal]
  }

  tree$node.label <- as.character(pp1_values)
  return(tree)
}
```

```{r}
tree <- extract_pp1_tree("Results/Phylogeny/species_tree_output.tree")
```

```{r}
# --- Root tree ---
tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "Zhuliangomyces_illinitus", resolve.root = TRUE)

# --- Fortify and add support ---
tree_data <- ggtree::fortify(tree)
tree_data$support <- NA
internal_nodes <- which(tree_data$isTip == FALSE)
tree_data$support[internal_nodes] <- as.numeric(tree$node.label)

# --- Base plot ---
p <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.6) %<+% tree_data +
  geom_tree(aes(color = support)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#000000", mid = "#ff0000", high = "green",
    midpoint = 0.40, na.value = "black"
  ) +

  # Tip labels with space (no clipping)
  geom_tiplab(
    size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
    align = TRUE, linesize = 0.3, offset = 0.03
  ) +

  # Internal support values
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip & !is.na(support) & support > 0.6,
      label = round(support, 2)
    ),
    hjust = -0.4, size = 2.5, color = "#317000"
  ) +

  # Layout fixes
  theme_minimal() +
  expand_limits(x = 1.1) + # force extra space on the right
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10) # top, right, bottom, left
  ) +
  labs(color = "ASTRAL pp1 Support")

# --- Save (no clipping) ---
ggsave("Amanita_tree_highlighted.png",
  plot = p, width = 12, height = 12,
  units = "in", dpi = 600, limitsize = FALSE
)
```

# Prep combination of Morphometic and Phylogenetic data

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Clean species names for matching
# -------------------------------

tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_trim() %>%
  stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
  gsub("'|\"", "", .)  # Remove quotes if present

```

```{r}

# Merge all
df <- pca %>% left_join(vol, by = "species") 

# -------------------------------
# Summarize morphometric + climate data per species
# -------------------------------
df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC1_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_volume_estimated)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species")

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Match tree tips and data
# -------------------------------
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))
cat("Species matched between data and tree:", length(species_in_both), "\n")

# Optional: Save unmatched species for review
unmatched_data <- setdiff(rownames(df_clean), tree$tip.label)
unmatched_tree <- setdiff(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))
writeLines(unmatched_data, "unmatched_data_species.txt")
writeLines(unmatched_tree, "unmatched_tree_species.txt")

# Prune tree and data to matched species
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_in_both))
df_pruned <- df_clean[species_in_both, ]
df_pruned <- df_pruned[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, rownames(df_pruned)), ]
stopifnot(rownames(df_pruned) == tree_pruned$tip.label)

```

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Match tree tips and data
# -------------------------------
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))


tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_in_both))
# Add a small branch length to avoid singularity
tree_pruned$edge.length[tree_pruned$edge.length == 0] <- 1e-8
node_backup <- tree_pruned$node.label
tree_pruned$node.label <- NULL

df_pruned <- df_clean[species_in_both, ]

# Ensure order matches
df_pruned <- df_pruned[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, rownames(df_pruned)), ]
stopifnot(rownames(df_pruned) == tree_pruned$tip.label)

df_pruned$species <- rownames(df_pruned)

# -------------------------------

```

# Blomberg’s K 

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Phylogenetic Signal Tests
# -------------------------------

names_PC1 <- df_pruned$PC1_mean
names(names_PC1) <- rownames(df_pruned)

names_volume <- df_pruned$avg_volume_estimated
names(names_volume) <- rownames(df_pruned)

# Blomberg’s K
K_PC1 <- phylosig(tree_pruned, df_pruned$PC1_mean, method = "K", test = TRUE)
K_volume <- phylosig(tree_pruned, df_pruned$avg_volume_estimated, method = "K", test = TRUE)

cat("Blomberg’s K for PC1:\n")
print(K_PC1)

cat("Blomberg’s K for Volume:\n")
print(K_volume)

```


# Pagel’s λ

```{r}

# Pagel’s λ using pgls
comp_data <- comparative.data(tree_pruned, df_pruned, names.col = "species", vcv = TRUE)

lambda_PC1 <- pgls(PC1_mean ~ 1, data = comp_data, lambda = "ML")
lambda_volume <- pgls(avg_volume_estimated ~ 1, data = comp_data, lambda = "ML")

cat("\nPagel's λ for PC1:\n")
summary(lambda_PC1)

cat("\nPagel's λ for Volume:\n")
summary(lambda_volume)

```



# visualize 

```{r}
# === 1. Continuous trait mapping (PC1) ===
jpeg("Plots/PC1_contMap.jpg", width = 2000, height = 3000, res = 300)  # High-res JPEG

# Prepare trait and color map
pc1_named <- df_pruned$PC1_mean
names(pc1_named) <- rownames(df_pruned)
obj_pc1 <- contMap(tree_pruned, pc1_named, plot = FALSE)

# Set plot margins and plot
par(mar = c(2, 2, 5, 2))  # Add space for title
plot(obj_pc1, legend = TRUE, fsize = 0.5, outline = FALSE, lwd = 3)
title("PC1 Shape Mapped on Phylogeny", cex.main = 1.5, font.main = 2, line = -.8)

dev.off()

```

```{r}
# === Continuous trait mapping (Volume) ===
jpeg("Plots/volume_contMap.jpg", width = 2000, height = 3000, res = 300)  # High-res JPEG
```

```{r}

     outline = FALSE,
     lwd = 3,

)
```
